title: Import members from a file
description: Bring in your gym's member list from an Excel or CSV file. You see every row before anything is saved.

file.title: The file
file.hint: An xlsx or csv file, up to {{rows}} rows and {{size}} MB. The first row holds the column names.
file.encoding: This file wasn't saved as UTF-8, so some letters may have been read wrong. If the names look broken, save it again in Excel as "CSV UTF-8".

problems.xls: This is an old Excel file (xls). Open it in Excel, save it as xlsx and choose it again.
problems.unreadable: This file can't be read. Choose an xlsx or csv file.
problems.too_big: This file is larger than {{size}} MB. Split it into several files.
problems.empty: This file is empty, or has no row with the column names.
problems.too_many_rows: This file has more than {{rows}} rows. Split it into several files.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: What each column of the file becomes. Change any that were recognized wrongly.
columns.missing: These are needed and no column was matched to them: {{fields}}
columns.kept: {{fields}} can't be used yet, but are kept with the import record for later.
columns.cardsKept: You may not give cards, so the card numbers are not given, only kept for later.

notesWarning.title: Every staff member who can see members reads the notes
notesWarning.text: Health info (illness, injury, pain) belongs in the medical notes, which only certain staff can see.
notesWarning.action: Import this column as medical notes

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Which branch the members of each branch in the file join.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Ready rows and rows with warnings are ticked. Rows that may be the same person are not, until you decide.
preview.checkFailed: Couldn't compare with existing members. Check the connection and try again.
preview.selectAll: Tick every row that can be imported

issues.phone_missing: No mobile number, and no emergency contact's number.
issues.phone_invalid: The mobile number is not valid: {{value}}
issues.birth_year_only: Only the birth year is given ({{value}}): the date stays empty and the year is kept.
issues.birth_date_invalid: The birth date can't be read ({{value}}): it stays empty.
issues.birth_date_future: The birth date is in the future ({{value}}): it stays empty.
issues.joined_invalid: The registration date can't be read ({{value}}): today is used.
issues.blood_type_unknown: Blood type not recognized ({{value}}): it stays empty.
issues.emergency_phone_invalid: The emergency contact's number is not valid ({{value}}): it stays empty.
issues.text_too_long: {{field}} is too long: it stays empty.
issues.phone_from_notes: No mobile of their own. This number was found in the notes and becomes their emergency contact's: {{value}}
issues.shared_phone_row: Same mobile as row {{row}}: that number becomes their emergency contact's.
issues.shared_phone_member: Same mobile as {{name}} (member {{number}}): that number becomes their emergency contact's.
issues.card_invalid: The card number is not valid ({{value}}): no card is given, the number is kept for later.
issues.card_decimal: The card number has 10 digits and is read as {{value}}: it works only with the same kind of reader.
issues.card_repeated: Same card as row {{row}}: imported without a card.
issues.card_taken: This card is already a member's: imported without a card.
issues.card_taken_member: This card is {{name}}'s (member {{number}}): imported without a card.
issues.card_blocked: This card is blocked: imported without a card.
issues.same_person_row: May be the same person as row {{row}}.
issues.same_person_member: May be the same person as {{name}} (member {{number}}).
issues.card_kept: The card number ({{value}}) is kept for later.
issues.already_member: Already there as {{name}} (member {{number}}): not imported again.

server.invalid_row: The server didn't accept this row: something in it is not valid.
server.phone_in_use: This mobile number is now another member's.
server.card_in_use: This card is now a member's.
server.no_branch_access: You don't have access to this branch.

import.confirmText: They are saved all together. If any of them can't be, none is saved and we tell you why.
import.readOnly: This gym is view only, so no members are imported.
import.refused: Nothing was saved: {{count}} rows were refused. The reasons are next to them, and they are now unticked. Import again to save the rest, or fix the file.
import.tooSlow: Nothing was saved: the server couldn't save them all in time. Split the file in two and import each part.
import.network: Nothing was saved: couldn't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
import.failed: Nothing was saved. Try again. If it keeps happening, contact Click Group.

done.title: {{count}} members imported
done.undone: The members of this import were archived.

undo.action: Archive all members from this import
undo.title: Archive the members of this import?
undo.description: Every member this import added is taken off the member list. Nobody is deleted, and you can reactivate any of them later.
undo.changed: {{count}} of these members were changed after the import. They are archived too.
undo.alreadyArchived: {{count}} members were already archived and stay as they are.
undo.reasonText: The reason can be up to 300 letters.

failures.import_undone: The members of this import were already archived.
failures.read_only: This gym is view only, so no members are archived.
failures.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
failures.failed: Archiving failed and nothing was changed. Try again.
